name: Demucs stems
tagline: Split any track into **drums, bass, vocals, other** (or 6 stems with guitar + piano). Use the stems as inputs for the other engines.

params.name: model
params.help: htdemucs = fast and good. htdemucs_ft = best quality, 4× slower. htdemucs_6s adds guitar + piano.

params.name: two_stems
params.help: Pick one to get just that stem plus everything else (e.g. vocals + instrumental).

params.name: shifts
params.help: Random-shift passes averaged together. Higher = slightly cleaner, slower.

notes:
- Stems land next to each other in the run folder, ready to drag into your DAW.
- Splitting a track you love, then feeding its **drums** into MusicGen continuation or its **melody stem** into MusicGen-Melody / Basic Pitch, is a great way to remix ideas.
